epicfight_dd:amber.name: Amber
tooltip: §7One might think this stone had captured the sun, as it looks as though it’s glowing a bright orange.

epicfight_dd:blood_knife.name: Blood Infused Knife
tooltip: §fThis weapon restores health to the wielder when they take another’s life.

§7These knives were used in the past by the Blood Cult. Because of their light weight and the properties of the blade, these knives were very popular. This popularity reached such a point that the gemstones from which the blade is made no longer exist today.

epicfight_dd:blood_ritus_dagger.name: Blood Ritual Dagger
tooltip: §fThis weapon restores health to the wielder when they take another’s life.

§7
This was once a sacred weapon, forged from mithril, but it was misused for cruel rituals by high-ranking figures in the Blood Cult.

epicfight_dd:bonecutting_saw.name: Bonecutting Saw
tooltip: §f§o"Tantum qui viam mali ambulant ei digni erunt."

§7
This weapon was primarily used by the Eques Mortis as an instrument of execution. After the Revolution, these weapons became a symbol of atrocity and were subsequently banned. Nevertheless, some of these examples are still in circulation today.

epicfight_dd:gloria.name: Gloria
tooltip: §7As great and mighty as it was, one day it was swallowed up by the maw of hell and abandoned by all the gods, only this relic remained...

epicfight_dd:glorious_charm.name: Glorious Charm
tooltip: §7It is said that the talisman is constructed from orichalcum, an alloy forged many thousands of years ago by a lost civilisation.

epicfight_dd:grimm.name: Grimm
tooltip: §7The metal still seems to be glowing in certain places, even though this weapon is probably thousands of years old!

epicfight_dd:hookclaws.name: Hookclaws
tooltip:
§7Weapon worn on the fist comprised of sharp parallel blades favored by those who lurk in the dark.

Claws can be equipped in both Hands.

epicfight_dd:horus_fang.name: Horus Fang
tooltip: §7This weapon was used primarily by the Horus Watchers, who ruled the desert long ago.

epicfight_dd:iron_fist.name: Iron Fist
tooltip:
§7This weapon was used for torture by the dungeon guards of the old kingdom.
The pointed prongs make it look like a fist-sized version of the Iron Maiden.

epicfight_dd:iudex_gundyr_halberd.name: Iudex Gundyr's Halberd
tooltip:
§7Halberd of Gundyr the Champion, received when he was charged with his duty.

This old cast-iron halberd has the power to break poise, and is said to never crumble, seeming to suggest that Gundyr was fated to eternal service from the beginning.

epicfight_dd:malachite.name: Malachite
tooltip: §7Parents place these stones under their children’s pillows to protect them from nightmares.

epicfight_dd:metal_plate.name: Metal Plate
tooltip: §7You’re not sure what materials this piece is made of, but there must be plenty of various materials.

epicfight_dd:milady.name: Milady
tooltip:
§7A light greatsword; that is, a sword whose blade matches the length of a greatsword, while being constrained to a minimal weight.
Nicknamed after ladies of noble status for its refined appearance. With cultivated form, one can wield this weapon as swiftly as one might a straight sword.

epicfight_dd:night_ritus_dagger.name: Night Ritual Dagger
tooltip: §fThis weapon restores stamina when you execute a target. This effect is more effective in moonlight.

§7
Like its counterpart, this weapon was forged from mithril, but under the influence of moonlight. It was therefore consecrated to Nox Obscura, the goddess of darkness. What became of this dagger afterwards, no one knows.

epicfight_dd:nightingale.name: Nightingale
tooltip: §7The blade of this spear is made of pure electrum, also known as water gold. The shaft itself is made of volcanic glass. Nightingale once belonged to a High Magistrate of the Night Cult.

epicfight_dd:peridot.name: Peridot
tooltip: §7Bright green, but no more dangerous than a pebble

epicfight_dd:poleblade.name: Poleblade
tooltip: §fThis weapon restores health to the wielder when they take another’s life.

§7
This weapon was used by the Blood Cult’s elite soldiers during the Unholy War. After that, it vanished without a trace and was never found…

epicfight_dd:poleblade_blade_part.name: Poleblade Blade Part
tooltip: §7It appears to be part of an ancient weapon

epicfight_dd:revenant.name: Revenant
tooltip: §7Buried deep within the catacombs now lies what was once forged in brilliant light. Yet after all these years of oblivion, this weapon is still fit for use.

epicfight_dd:ruby.name: Ruby
tooltip: §7This deep wine-red stone seems to absorb all light.

epicfight_dd:rusted_metal_plate.name: Rusted Metal Plate
tooltip: §7This piece of metal is so badly rusted that it is no longer suitable for forging. However, there may be other uses for it.

epicfight_dd:saber.name: Saber
tooltip: §7Following reunification, a neutral party was established to uphold peace. To meet this challenge, they were entrusted with sacred sabres, whose ornamentation embodies the imagery of justice.

epicfight_dd:scythe.name: Scythe
tooltip: §7It is a rather old scythe that was once used on farms. However, the blade appears to have been reinforced.

epicfight_dd:vitreus.name: Vitreus
tooltip: §7The blade of this weapon is so transparent that you might think it were made of glass. There is a glowing, bright-red ruby on the hilt.

epicfight_dd:wooden_battlestaff.name: Big Stick
tooltip: §7This is just a normal stick, right?

§8Unique gems from the addition item fill the base item's empty sockets; gems that don't fit are lost

fallen_gems_affixes:sigil_of_transmutati.name: Sigil of Transmutation
